kpis.description_fr: CA segment Cloud (SSD enterprise NAND, datacenter AI) : tendance accelerante avec adoption AI inference, +195% FY25.
kpis.description_en: Cloud segment revenue (enterprise NAND SSD, AI datacenter): accelerating with AI inference adoption, +195% FY25.

kpis.description_fr: CA segment Client (SSD PC, embedded mobile, OEM) : 56% du CA total, stabilisation post-cycle PC 2023.
kpis.description_en: Client segment revenue (PC SSD, embedded mobile, OEM): 56% of total revenue, stabilization post-2023 PC cycle.

kpis.description_fr: CA segment Consumer (cartes SD, USB, SSD portable, retail) : franchise marque historique SanDisk, 31% du CA.
kpis.description_en: Consumer segment revenue (SD cards, USB, portable SSD, retail): historic SanDisk brand franchise, 31% of revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Marge brute NAND : cyclicite extreme, 7.1% creux FY23 -> 30.1% rebond FY25. Tendance prix NAND determinante.
kpis.description_en: NAND gross margin: extreme cyclicality, 7.1% trough FY23 -> 30.1% rebound FY25. NAND pricing trend critical.

kpis.description_fr: Depenses R&D : 15.4% du CA FY25, intensite investissement NAND elevee pour BiCS9/BiCS10 + JV Kioxia process technology.
kpis.description_en: R&D expense: 15.4% of FY25 revenue, high NAND investment intensity for BiCS9/BiCS10 + Kioxia JV process technology.

_notes: Spin-off Western Digital fevrier 2025. Annee fiscale juin (FY25 = juillet 2024 - juin 2025). History limitee a 3 ans car les 10-K SanDisk standalone n'existent que depuis 2025 ; les 3 annees affichees sont fournies dans le 10-K initial via comparative.
